name: Mifune Sayuri
source:
Sayuri is an attractive young woman with an air of dignity about her. Although she tries to deny it, she has the rare ability to see ghosts. After getting caught up in fight with the ghost that appears at the academy, she decides she can't ignore her talents and makes up her mind to finally face her own past.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
